evidence_requirements.statement: The hostile matrix has nine individually identifiable scenario cases with distinguishable pass/fail results.

Forbidden credit purchase, rate-limit reset consumption, identity rotation, and secondary-provider fallback operations are asserted independently, including a passing genuine preflight exception path.
A durable repository artifact records the exact cp1252 baseline reproduction commands, baseline revision, environment, and observed two failures, independently rerun for this change.
Preflight decision behavior, RuntimeProfile integration, and the confirmed public status/explain/audit CLI behavior remain unchanged.
KEEL verification and landing verification both pass for the sealed candidate.

non_goals: Do not change preflight decision logic, RuntimeProfile integration, or public CLI output.
Do not modify the two cp1252-failing attestation tests or their implementation files.
Do not merge to main without separate authorization.
objective: Close NS1 traceability evidence gaps without changing behavior

requirements.statement: Improve hostile-matrix and forbidden-operation traceability without weakening aggregate assertions.
Record and independently reproduce the cp1252 baseline failures at the main baseline.
Preserve preflight, RuntimeProfile, and public CLI behavior.
Produce KEEL verification evidence for the exact candidate and landing verification.

units.title: Add named scenario and forbidden-operation assertions
Retain CLI contract coverage and verify candidate
